name: Tales from Schwarzerblitz - Drinking Shark Rhapsody
source:
Welcome to "Jackson's", New Langdon's finest cafe!
It's your first day as a bartender, the newest member of a quirky motley crew!

Work under the egida of the Man with Hat himself - Vincent Jackson - in this short standalone visual novel set in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1287800/Schwarzerblitz/]Schwarzerblitz[/url] universe.

[From [url=https://dermondhase.itch.io/tales-from-schwarzerblitz-drinking-shark-rhapsody]Itch.io[/url]]
